title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect on Model Complexity
text: Adding L2 regularization tends to shrink the coefficients of the model, which can lead to a simpler model. How might this affect the bias of the model?

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Consider the bias-variance tradeoff. Regularization typically increases bias but decreases variance. How does this tradeoff affect the model's performance on the training set?

title: Impact on Training Set
text: With L2 regularization, the model's complexity is reduced, leading to an increase in bias. What is the expected behavior in the training set?
